title: Manifold-Pareto dual 70B/72B ensemble: geometric fusion + CALA gate + conformal control

protocol.cala_sign: logit - tau * Phi * log(prior); the brief's '+' would boost the majority class
protocol.selection: 1-SE rule on 5-fold stratified OOF of the training split; simplest candidate within 1 SE
protocol.peak_track: objective OOF accuracy; gate: OOF accuracy >= train majority prior and no class > 95% of predictions
protocol.robust_track: objective OOF (balanced accuracy + macro F1)/2; gate: no class > 95% of predictions and no zero-recall class
protocol.conformal: refit on 80% of train rows, calibrate on 20%, alpha=0.1; marginal and class-conditional
protocol.test_labels: read after every selection and every test-score computation; scoring only
protocol.features: full 8192-d per view, fits on training rows only, no random projection
